rejected.title: Non-innocent Bromide Redirects Sulfur Oxygenation through O–O Bond Cleavage in a Nonheme Fe(III)–Superoxo System
rejected.reason: The article's central contribution is mechanistic analysis of a biomimetic iron model system, not a general preparative organic synthesis method.
rejected.evidenceBasis: The fresh Crossref abstract describes a computational study of a defined biomimetic model transformation and focuses on pathway ordering and intermediate assignment. It does not report a transferable substrate scope, isolated product series, preparative yields, or a target synthesis route.
rejected.challengeReason: A real chemical transformation is present, so the boundary was challenged. However, the available article-specific abstract supports a mechanistic model-system study rather than a general preparative method; the transformation alone is insufficient under the current scope contract.
